import json
from collections import Counter
with open('items.jsonl') as f: items=[json.loads(s) for s in f]
with open('answers.jsonl') as f: answers=[json.loads(s) for s in f]
assert len(items)==len(answers)
for item, answer in zip(items,answers):
 assert item['item_id']==answer['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,item['slots']+1)}

 assert set(answer['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in {'ъ','ь','other','u'} for v in answer['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in {'high','low'} for v in answer['confidence'].values())
c=Counter(v for a in answers for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items;',dict(c),'; items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
PY
